method: Bounded public-web search of primary military-analysis institutions, specialist outlets, public newsletters, and indexed analyst publications. Exact-date and exact-title queries were used, with screening against the earlier 00:00–05:00 UTC shard and international-media overlap. No authentication, access-control bypass, timestamp substitution, inferred article identifier, map capture, binary download, or precise operational-location retention was used.

sources_checked.result: Exact-title and exact-date searches for Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, August 4 and August 5, 2026 did not resolve a stable primary page during the bounded pass. Search results surfaced older assessments, but no exact-window item suitable for canonical registration.

access_failures.detail: Search indexes did not expose stable August 4 or August 5 pages during the pass. Earlier direct-access history included HTTP 403, and no access-control bypass was attempted.

Public social and newsletter search did not expose a stable exact-window primary post with both canonical URL and verifiable publication time. Relay or secondary-publication times were not substituted.
No qualifying page was admitted and no page bytes, content hash, complete revision history, map, or binary artifact was captured.

artifact_capture.reason: No qualifying canonical primary source item was resolved, and no permitted immutable artifact was available for capture.

coverage_gaps: The result is a bounded zero-item discovery outcome, not evidence that no military analyst published during the interval.
Search-engine indexing may lag analyst institutions, newsletters, and public social platforms.
ISW and CTP exact-date primary pages were not resolved, and historical direct access restrictions were not bypassed.
Secondary media containing analyst commentary was excluded rather than treated as a primary analyst publication.
The scan was limited to selected established institutions and public archives and is not exhaustive across all analysts or languages.
No maps, full text, images, video, page bytes, or immutable artifacts were downloaded or hashed.
No analytical assertion was independently assessed or converted into a claim, observation, territorial conclusion, or report narrative.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement routes, active-unit locations, target coordinates, vulnerable-facility details, or map geometry were persisted.
No authenticated platform data, private material, or access-control bypass was used.
A zero-result receipt was preferred over inferred publication identities, relay timestamp substitution, or secondary-source promotion.
